rca of the issue: Row component in TableView.jsx used isSpv at line 215 (onAddInline conditional) but did not destructure it from props. React threw ReferenceError at render time only when the Table view was rendered with a non-empty task list AND the Penerima column tried to render the AnggotaSelect (which passes onAddInline). SPV wasn't affected in initial dev because isSpv resolved at compile from parent closure scope — but the actual JSX is inside Row's own scope so it always broke. Fix: pass isSpv from TableView parent props (already available) into Row and add to Row's destructure with default true (backward-compatible). Reproduction: login as anggota, /tasks → click Tabel → runtime overlay 'isSpv is not defined'. After fix: Tabel view renders, Hasil Tugas column visible, 'Dari Budi' badge visible, Monitor dialog opens correctly.
